name: baci-website-builder
description: Create and edit a private Baci homepage, preview the exact draft and request owner approval to publish it.

interface.longDescription: Link your Baci merchant account to create a private store homepage, request asynchronous edits, apply a ready edit and preview the exact revision. Publishing requires a separate signed-in owner approval in Baci. Supports the portable homepage layout, copy and theme; other pages, SEO, domains, catalog setup, payments and launch requirements remain in the Baci dashboard. Publication is reported live only after public delivery verification.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me create or update my Baci homepage, preview it, and request approval before publishing.
